program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j | !is_a@i & !is_b@i & is_c@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j, !is_a@i & !is_a@j & is_b@j & !is_c@j | !is_a@j & is_b@j & !is_c@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(true, !is_bos@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_1@j | !is_a@j & !h1_1@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(h2_1@i | !is_c@i, true)
accept = !is_bos & !is_a & !is_b & !h2_1 & !h3_1 | is_c & !h2_1 & !h3_1

output accept
